payload.taskDescription: Replace the shelf placeholder with CaseShelfPage, CaseShelf, CaseCard, and CaseFormDialog. Load case summaries from the repository, sort by nearest exam date with undated cases last and then by updatedAt descending, and render title, subject, exam date, counts, a closure badge when closedAt is present, and last modified. Add create and edit flows with inline title validation, optional subject and exam date, 44px actions, empty state, route wiring in src/app/routes.tsx, and a recoverable database-error state with Retry and import guidance. Do not implement case deletion, storage warnings, readiness counts, or backup actions.
